name: West Virginia Wesleyan College
tuition_note: Private college, single published rate. 2026-27 tuition & fees = $34,822 (tuition $33,304 + student activity fee $100 + technology fee $394 + general fee $1,024) from wvwc.edu/financial-aid-scholarships/total-direct-cost/. Housing is standard room only $5,962 from same page (average housing $7,396); board/food not included in housing figure.
